audience: support agents and team leads who answer customer conversations in Chatwoot Cloud

useCases.title: See the conversations that need an agent
useCases.text: Count the open and unassigned conversations, then list them by status, inbox or team.

useCases.title: Read a conversation before you reply
useCases.text: Open one conversation to see its contact, status, priority, labels and assignee. Then read its messages, oldest first.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their past conversations
useCases.text: Search contacts by name, email or phone, open one contact, then list all conversations of that contact.

useCases.title: Reply to a customer or add a private note
useCases.text: Find a saved reply template, then add a message to the conversation. A private note stays internal; a reply goes to the customer by email or chat.

useCases.title: Assign a conversation to an agent or team
useCases.text: Look up the agents and teams, then assign the conversation to one agent or one team.

useCases.title: Set the status and priority of a conversation
useCases.text: Set a conversation to open, resolved, pending or snoozed. Then set its priority, or clear it.
